scope: Discriminate whether current G9 surface drift can be repaired as syntax-only normalization without introducing missing control-flow/operator semantics.
freshness_note: Canonical revision/hash remained unchanged immediately before durable run write. Concurrent commits were reread; this run writes only isolated trigger-run artifacts and does not mutate current grammar/canonical state.
result_summary: Concurrent union-type grammar mismatch is resolved and must not be carried as a current blocker.
Effectful conditional control cannot be naively normalized to an eager ordinary function call/select.
Flat operator-chain grammar without explicit precedence/associativity produces materially divergent execution.
Digit-leading bare 4B_emits remains a surface incompatibility; rename or explicit escaped/sigiled identifier is safer than broadening bare identifier lexing.
No FRANK-specific new primitive is justified by this run; the required deltas are general-purpose language/evaluator semantics.
